scope: Agent inspected decoded final start/action/result/return frames for every changed insert, plus 375px mobile contact sheet; source action reviewed as ordered decoded frames.

sourceActionReview.method: Ordered decoded source frames, 0.5–1 second spacing, examined before these choices
sourceActionReview.annotationDecision: Reuse source-frame targets only where source identity and time overlap; clear before later motion. New targets require visual checking.

limits: Frame inspection is not continuous full-video viewing or full-audio listening.
Game imagery is observable evidence; exact hidden quantities are only in the labeled explanation model.

additionalInspectedFrame.finding: Yellow cockpit-side panel and tracking circle match the spoken yellow example; red engine shell is visibly distinct; fixed captions and model remain readable.
